years.table_title: Race, Sex, and Ethnicity of Victim by Race, Sex, and Ethnicity of Offender, 2023

W_on_B.label: White offender, Black or African American victim
W_on_B.per_capita_null_reason: no cited population denominator has been joined for Table 6 race categories (race, not Hispanic origin)

B_on_W.label: Black offender, White victim
B_on_W.per_capita_null_reason: no cited population denominator has been joined for Table 6 race categories (race, not Hispanic origin)

notes: Table 6 is single victim / single offender only. Multiple-victim cases are outside this table.
Offenders of unknown race are excluded from the direction counts (112 White-victim and 199 Black-victim cases).
Race is not non-Hispanic. Hispanic origin is a separate, non-mandatory ethnicity field. These counts are not comparable, without further work, to the NCVS non-Hispanic White / Black baseline.
Table 6 has no victim-age breakdown, so child-specific claims cannot be made from this table.
Per-capita rates are not published here; a per-capita view will sit next to the raw counts once a cited population denominator is joined.
